Bob Gem
Computer science graduate with solid foundation in full-stack development and systems programming. Proficient across multiple modern languages and frameworks including, C++, Java, and Flutter. Demonstrates capability in building scalable applications utilising cloud infrastructure and computer vision technologies.

django-rest-framework-contrib —
Python · personal repo
Small collection of helper utilities I keep around for my own Django side projects, mostly tweaks to serializers and viewsets.
Mainly maintained on weekends; occasional contributions from a handful of other people.

react-distributed-state —
TypeScript · personal repo
Personal experiment exploring how to share React component state across browser tabs using broadcast channels.
Started as a learning exercise to dig into React internals; kept it on GitHub for my own reference.
